title: The True and Invisible Rosicrucian Order Original Edition
subtitle: An Examination of the Rosicrucian Allegory, and a Survey of the Meaning of the Rosicrucian Grades
author: Paul Case
imprint: The Frances Bacon Library, Claremont, California, 1927
publicDomain: Published in the US in 1927: in the public domain there since 1 January 2023; Case died 1954.
note: The first edition, of 1927, the signed edition of sixty-four copies, set from a transcription of copy no. 16 typed in 2003 and compared with the book. The transcription's typing slips are corrected; the figures it does not have are marked where they stood. The later editions, enlarged by Case, are not this text.
